<title>Malothu Chandrashekar</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,300;9..40,400;9..40,500;9..40,600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* Layout: dark hero + dark accents over warm-light body */
:root {
  --h-bg:    #0D0A12;
  --h-fg:    #EDE8DF;
  --h-muted: #76706A;
  --h-rule:  #221E28;
  --h-gold:  #C9A45A;
  --h-gold2: rgba(201,164,90,.18);

  --bg:      #F7F3ED;
  --fg:      #0C0A07;
  --surface: #EDE8E0;
  --gold:    #B8914A;
  --gold-d:  #D4B882;
  --muted:   #8A7F72;
  --rule:    #DDD5C8;

  --font-d: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif;
  --font-b: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
  color-scheme: light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg:      #0D0A12;
    --fg:      #EDE8DF;
    --surface: #18141E;
    --gold:    #C9A45A;
    --gold-d:  #7A6035;
    --muted:   #76706A;
    --rule:    #221E28;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg:      #0D0A12;
  --fg:      #EDE8DF;
  --surface: #18141E;
  --gold:    #C9A45A;
  --gold-d:  #7A6035;
  --muted:   #76706A;
  --rule:    #221E28;
  color-scheme: dark;
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
  font-family: var(--font-b);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* ── NAV ── */
.nav {
  position: fixed;
  top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  left: 0; right: 0;
  z-index: 200;
  background: rgba(13,10,18,.88);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--h-rule);
  padding: 14px max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.nav-name {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--h-fg);
  letter-spacing: .01em;
}
.nav-pill {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--h-gold);
  border: 1px solid rgba(201,164,90,.35);
  padding: 4px 11px;
  border-radius: 20px;
}
.nav-dot {
  width: 6px; height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--h-gold);
  animation: blink 2.4s ease infinite;
}
@keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 55%{opacity:.2} }

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero {
  background: var(--h-bg);
  padding-top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 80px);
  padding-bottom: 72px;
  padding-left:  max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  padding-right: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
}
.hero-inner {
  max-width: 1080px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px;
  gap: 72px;
  align-items: center;
}
.hero-eyebrow {
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: .13em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--h-gold);
  font-weight: 500;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}
.hero-eyebrow::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1; max-width: 56px;
  height: 1px; background: var(--h-gold); opacity: .4;
}
.hero-h1 {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: clamp(50px, 8vw, 100px);
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: .97;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
  color: var(--h-fg);
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}
.hero-h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--h-gold); }
.hero-sub {
  font-size: clamp(14px, 1.8vw, 17px);
  color: var(--h-muted);
  max-width: 500px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  font-weight: 300;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.hero-tags {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}
.htag {
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: .07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--h-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--h-rule);
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 2px;
}
.hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.btn-p {
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--h-bg); background: var(--h-gold);
  padding: 11px 24px; border-radius: 2px;
  text-decoration: none; transition: opacity .15s;
}
.btn-p:hover { opacity: .88; }
.btn-g {
  font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--h-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--h-rule);
  padding: 11px 24px; border-radius: 2px;
  text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .15s, color .15s;
}
.btn-g:hover { border-color: var(--h-muted); color: var(--h-fg); }

/* PHOTO */
.hero-photo {
  width: 260px; height: 260px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 2px solid var(--h-gold);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px var(--h-gold2), 0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  justify-self: center;
}
.hero-photo img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center top;
  display: block;
}

/* ── STATS ── */
.stats {
  background: #110E18;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--h-rule);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--h-rule);
  padding-left:  max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  padding-right: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
}
.stats-inner {
  max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
}
.stat {
  padding: 28px 24px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--h-rule);
}
.stat:last-child { border-right: none; }
.stat-n {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: 38px; font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--h-gold); line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.stat-l { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--h-muted); }

/* ── SHARED LIGHT ── */
.sec {
  padding-block: 72px;
  padding-left:  max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  padding-right: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
}
.sec-in { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
.ey {
  font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .13em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.sh {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 38px);
  font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.1;
  margin: 0 0 44px; text-wrap: balance;
}
hr.rl { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }

/* ── SKILLS ── */
.skills-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 36px;
}
.skill-col-head {
  font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold);
}
.stags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.stag {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--fg);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, color .15s;
}
.stag:hover {
  background: var(--gold);
  border-color: var(--gold);
  color: #fff;
}

/* ── ANIMATED SHOWCASE ── */
.showcase {
  background: var(--h-bg);
  padding-block: 64px;
  padding-left:  max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  padding-right: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  overflow: hidden;
}
.showcase-in { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
.showcase-top {
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 36px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.showcase-h {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.2vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 300; color: var(--h-fg); line-height: 1.1;
}
.showcase-h em { font-style: italic; color: var(--h-gold); }
.reel-track-wrap { overflow: hidden; }
.reel-track {
  display: flex; gap: 16px;
  animation: scroll-reel 22s linear infinite;
  width: max-content;
}
.reel-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }
@keyframes scroll-reel {
  0%   { transform: translateX(0); }
  100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
.reel-card {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 220px;
  background: var(--h-rule);
  border: 1px solid #2E2838;
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 22px 20px 18px;
  transition: border-color .2s;
}
.reel-card:hover { border-color: var(--h-gold); }
.reel-icon {
  font-size: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px;
  color: var(--h-gold);
}
.reel-title {
  font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--h-fg); margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.2;
}
.reel-desc {
  font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--h-muted); line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ── WORK ── */
.work-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 2px;
  background: var(--rule);
  outline: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.card {
  background: var(--bg); padding: 30px 28px 26px;
  transition: background .18s; min-width: 0;
}
.card:hover { background: var(--surface); }
.card-idx {
  font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .08em;
  color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 14px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.card-title {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.1; margin: 0 0 4px;
}
.card-brand { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 14px; }
.card-desc  { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.fmt-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.fmt {
  font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .06em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold);
  border: 1px solid var(--gold-d);
  padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ── APPROACH band ── */
.approach {
  background: var(--surface);
  padding-block: 72px;
  padding-left:  max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  padding-right: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
}
.approach-in { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
.approach-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 60px;
}
.a-lead {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: clamp(20px, 2.8vw, 28px);
  font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.35; margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.a-body {
  font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted);
  line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.tools { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.tool-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  padding: 13px 16px; background: var(--bg); font-size: 13.5px;
}
.tool-icon { width: 22px; text-align: center; color: var(--gold); }
.tool-name { font-weight: 500; flex: 1; }
.tool-note { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); }

/* ── FOOTER ── */
.footer {
  background: var(--h-bg);
  padding-block: 64px 48px;
  padding-left:  max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));
  padding-right: max(28px, env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
}
.footer-in { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
.cta-h {
  font-family: var(--font-d);
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5vw, 60px);
  font-weight: 300; color: var(--h-fg);
  line-height: 1.08; margin-bottom: 20px; text-wrap: balance;
}
.cta-h em { font-style: italic; color: var(--h-gold); }
.cta-layout { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.contact-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-end; }
.c-row { text-align: right; }
.c-label { font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--h-muted); display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.c-val { font-size: 14px; color: var(--h-fg); }
.footer-bar {
  margin-top: 48px; padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--h-rule);
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--h-muted);
  letter-spacing: .04em; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;
}

/* ── ENTRANCE ANIMATIONS ── */
@keyframes fadeUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.hero-eyebrow { animation: fadeUp .6s .05s ease both; }
.hero-h1      { animation: fadeUp .7s .15s ease both; }
.hero-sub     { animation: fadeUp .6s .28s ease both; }
.hero-tags    { animation: fadeUp .6s .38s ease both; }
.hero-ctas    { animation: fadeUp .6s .48s ease both; }
.hero-photo   { animation: fadeUp .8s .22s ease both; }

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 44px; }
  .hero-photo { width: 180px; height: 180px; order: -1; justify-self: left; }
  .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .stat:nth-child(2) { border-right: none; }
  .stat:nth-child(3) { border-right: 1px solid var(--h-rule); }
  .skills-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .work-grid   { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .approach-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 36px; }
  .cta-layout { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
  .contact-block { align-items: flex-start; }
  .c-row { text-align: left; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .stats-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .stat { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--h-rule); }
  .stat:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .sec { padding-block: 52px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-eyebrow,.hero-h1,.hero-sub,.hero-tags,.hero-ctas,.hero-photo { animation: none; }
  .reel-track { animation: none; }
  .nav-dot { animation: none; }
}

/* ── CARD IMAGE ── */
.card-img {
  margin: -30px -28px 24px;
  overflow: hidden; height: 165px;
  cursor: pointer; position: relative;
}
.card-img::after {
  content: 'Click to expand';
  position: absolute; bottom: 10px; right: 12px;
  font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .05em;
  color: #fff; opacity: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 2px;
  transition: opacity .2s; pointer-events: none;
}
.card-img:hover::after { opacity: 1; }
.card-img img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover; object-position: top left; display: block;
  transition: transform .4s ease;
}
.card-img:hover img { transform: scale(1.04); }

/* ── LIGHTBOX ── */
.lb {
  display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 400;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,.9);
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  padding: 24px; cursor: pointer;
}
.lb.open { display: flex; }
.lb img {
  max-width: 92vw; max-height: 86vh;
  border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 24px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  cursor: default; pointer-events: none;
}
.lb-x {
  position: absolute; top: 18px; right: 22px;
  font-size: 30px; color: #fff; cursor: pointer;
  line-height: 1; opacity: .6; transition: opacity .15s;
}
.lb-x:hover { opacity: 1; }
</style>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav class="nav">
  <div class="nav-name">Malothu Chandrashekar</div>
  <div class="nav-pill"><span class="nav-dot"></span>Open to roles</div>
</nav>

<!-- ANIMATED SHOWCASE / CONTENT REEL -->
<section class="showcase">
  <div class="showcase-in">
    <div class="showcase-top">
      <h2 class="showcase-h">Content I can <em>make &amp; ship</em></h2>
      <div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--h-muted);">Scroll to pause</div>

      <div class="reel-track">

        <div class="reel-card"><div class="reel-icon">▶</div><div class="reel-title">Campaign Films</div><div class="reel-desc">Long-form brand storytelling for launches, occasions and IPs</div></div>
        <div class="reel-card"><div class="reel-icon">◈</div><div class="reel-title">Reels &amp; Short Video</div><div class="reel-desc">Hook-first, platform-native vertical content</div></div>

<!-- LIGHTBOX -->
<div class="lb" id="lb" onclick="closeLb()">
  <span class="lb-x" onclick="closeLb()">&#x2715;</span>
  <img src="" alt="" id="lb-img" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
</div>
<script>
function openLb(el){
  var src = el.querySelector('img').src;
  document.getElementById('lb-img').src = src;
  document.getElementById('lb').classList.add('open');
}
function closeLb(){
  document.getElementById('lb').classList.remove('open');
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape') closeLb(); });
</script>
